title: Fixed a plain value written into an `autocomplete` or `dropdown` cell whose `source` is an array of `key` and `value` objects being stored as the bare label. The matching object is now stored, so a paste, `setDataAtCell()` and autofill behave like the cell editor, which already resolved the label, and a `strict` column no longer marks a valid pasted option as invalid. Undo and redo now restore such a cell exactly as it was, instead of rebuilding the object with the label as its key.
